companyNotes: Huawei Thailand is a management and support hub for telecom products and solutions, serving carrier networks, enterprise customers, and industry customers. The program offers rotations, mentorship, structured training, and hands-on work across ICT solutions, 5G, cloud, and network infrastructure.
jobDescription: Support delivery and management of ICT solutions for carrier networks, enterprise, and industry customers. Assist in pre-sales and post-sales activities, including technical proposals, solution design, and customer communication. Collaborate with product, engineering, marketing, and sales teams. Participate in training and on-the-job learning in telecom technologies such as 5G, cloud, and network infrastructure at Huawei Headquarters or regional hubs. Contribute to documentation, reporting, and data analysis for decision-making and customer engagement. Opportunities include Sales Engineer, Network Product Manager, Wireless Product Manager, IT/AI Engineer, IT Application Engineer, Core Network Engineer, IP Engineer, Service Partner Enablement Engineer, Data Center Electrical Engineer, Project Engineer, and related roles.
letter: I am interested in the Huawei Fresh Graduate Program 2026 at Huawei Technologies (Thailand) Co., Ltd. because it connects closely with both my engineering background and the direction I want to grow in: telecom systems, cloud infrastructure, customer-focused ICT solutions, and practical software delivery. Huawei Thailand's role as a management and support hub for carrier networks, enterprise customers, and industry customers is especially meaningful to me because it combines technology depth with real business and operational impact.

My background is in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, and my master's study in Electrical Engineering has focused on telecommunication and networking systems. Professionally, I have worked as a Software Engineer across full-stack development, backend services, cloud, and DevOps. In my current work, I build and maintain TypeScript and Node.js backend services, REST APIs, PostgreSQL workflows, and production delivery pipelines using AWS, Docker, Nginx, Linux, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD practices. I also use Jest, unit testing, and integration testing to improve reliability and release confidence.

I believe this experience matches the program's need for fast learners who can support ICT solution delivery, technical documentation, solution design, data analysis, and communication across teams. I am also strongly interested in the program's exposure to 5G, cloud, network infrastructure, IT/AI engineering, core network, IP engineering, and product-related roles. My research and project experience in AI, authentication, metaverse systems, and document workflows has trained me to learn technical domains quickly, explain ideas clearly, and connect implementation details with broader system goals.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Huawei Thailand while learning from the rotational program, senior mentorship, and structured training environment. Thank you for considering my application. I would be glad to discuss how my software engineering, cloud, DevOps, AI, and telecom-related background can support Huawei's customers and future ICT projects.
